actionCoreGaveUp: The core keeps quitting, so Hop stopped restarting it
actionCoreRestarted: The core quit unexpectedly and was restarted
actionReadGeodata: Couldn't read the rule data status
actionSystemProxyOff: Couldn't turn off the system proxy
actionSystemProxyOn: Couldn't turn on the system proxy
actionWatchTraffic: Lost the connection to the core
connectionAddRule: Add a rule for this connection
connectionsEmptyHint: Hop isn't set as the system proxy. Point a browser or app's proxy at {address} (HTTP or SOCKS5) and its connections will show up here.
connectionsFilter: Filter by host, app or rule
connectionsNoMatchHint: No connection has a host, rule or node containing “{query}”.
connectionsSubtitle: See which route each app is taking
coreChecking: Checking that the new core runs
coreLockedByTun: The core can't be replaced while TUN is on. Turn it off first.
coreNewDev: Version {version} is available. The development core comes from HOP_MIHOMO_BINARY and isn't upgraded here.
coreNewUpgrade: Version {version} is available. The proxy pauses for a second or two while upgrading, and the new core is used only after it passes a check.
exitIpTip: The exit IP of the default route. Sites on dedicated routes, such as AI, may differ. Click to copy.
fileTooLarge: “{name}” is over {limit} MB and wasn't read.
flyoutNoDelays: No speed test results yet. Click “Test speed” to see which node is fastest.
flyoutNoSubscription: No subscription in use. Open the main window to add one.
geodataNote: GeoSite and GeoIP data, updated weekly. The core restarts once after an update.
helperInstalled: Installed. With TUN on, it runs the core with system privileges.
helperNeedsUpdate: Needs an update. Turning on TUN next time asks to update it.
helperNotInstalled: Not installed. Turning on TUN asks to install it.
heroEmpty: Import a subscription and the route your traffic takes will show here
lanAccountOff: Devices can connect without a username or password.
lanAccountOn: Devices must enter a username and password to connect.
lanFirewallNote: The first time you turn this on, the system may ask whether to allow incoming connections. Choose Allow. Only connections from your home or office network are accepted; those from the internet are refused.
lanIntro: Let phones and computers on the same network get online through this computer. On the other device, enter the proxy address below in its network settings.
lanNoNetwork: Not connected to a local network
lanOpenWarning: Any device on the same network can use your subscription's data. Don't use this on public Wi-Fi.
lanProtocols: Both HTTP and SOCKS5 are supported
logsEmptyHint: The core's activity appears here live, such as which rule a connection matched and why a node failed to connect.
logsSubtitle: A record of connections and rules
modeHintDirect: Everything goes direct, nothing through the proxy
modeHintGlobal: All traffic goes through the proxy
modeHintRule: Rules decide what goes through the proxy and what goes direct
portInvalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max} for the proxy port
portNote: Takes effect right away and the system proxy follows. Apps you gave the old port to need changing by hand.
portSkipped: The port you chose, {chosen}, is in use by another program, so Hop is using {fallback} for now. Free it and restart, or pick another one here.
routePlanNote: {name} · After a speed test, Auto switches to the lowest-latency node
ruleChooseTypeTarget: Choose a rule type and where it goes.
ruleDialogNote: Rules are checked before the subscription's, and the LAN direct rule still comes first.
ruleHintCidr: Matches this address range without resolving a domain, such as 192.0.2.0/24
ruleHintDomain: Matches only this exact domain, such as api.example.com
ruleHintKeyword: Matches any domain containing this text, such as example
ruleHintProcess: Matches by this computer's process name, such as Telegram
ruleHintSuffix: Matches this domain and its subdomains, such as example.com
rulesEmpty: No custom rules yet. Traffic follows the current rules.
rulesOrderNote: Rules match in order, ahead of the subscription's rules.
settingsAutoUpdateNote: Refreshes saved subscriptions at this interval. Local configs aren't refreshed. After a failure it waits for the next interval.
settingsClarityNote: Higher values make the glass clearer
settingsCommandCopied: Terminal proxy command copied. Paste it into a terminal.
settingsLaunchAtLoginNote: Runs in the menu bar after you log in, without opening a window
settingsLicense: Released under GPL-3.0. The bundled mihomo core is GPL-3.0 too.
settingsMenuBarSpeedNote: Shows live upload and download speed next to the menu bar icon
settingsSubtitle: Set Hop up your way and let it run quietly
settingsTerminalProxyNote: Terminals don't use the system proxy. Paste this command and that window goes through Hop. Not needed with TUN.
settingsThemeNote: Glass background colors. Takes effect immediately.
settingsTimeoutNote: Shorter is faster, but slow routes may be counted as timed out
startupFailedMessage: Hop ran into a problem while starting and has quit.
statsChartDescription: Daily traffic through Hop, proxy and direct combined
statsEmpty: No traffic has gone through Hop yet.
statsSubtitle: Every bit of traffic, clearly traced
subAddFirstHint: Add your first config and start using it.
subAddHint: Save a subscription or local config without changing the route in use.
subAddressScheme: The subscription address must start with http:// or https://.
subConfigBlank: The config can't be only whitespace.
subConfigMissing: Paste the config, or choose a config file.
subConfigTooLarge: The config file can't be larger than {limit} MB.
subContentPlaceholder: Paste a Clash config or node links…
subDaysLeft: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
subDeleteActive: “{name}” is in use. Choose a replacement subscription; it's deleted once the switch succeeds.
subDeleteAfterSwitch: It's deleted after the switch succeeds. Hop won't pick a route for you.
subDeleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? The subscription in use isn't affected.
subDeleteLast: “{name}” is the last subscription. After deleting it nothing is configured and Hop no longer proxies through a subscription.
subEditConfigHint: Edit the name, rule setting and config content. The new content replaces the old only after it checks out.
subEditHint: Edit the name, address and rule setting. The new address replaces the old content only after it checks out.
subEditKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the current config. Pasting or choosing a file replaces all of it.
subEmptyNote: Add a subscription to start choosing routes.
subApplying: Loading the subscription. The first load downloads its remote rule sets, which can take up to a minute.
subLocalNameHint: Choosing a file fills in its name. If you leave the name empty, it shows as “{fallback}”.
subNameHint: If you leave the name empty, the source domain is used.
subPageNote: Kept separately and switched when you need. Adding one doesn't change the current route.
subPasteHint: Paste a Clash config or node links, or read them from a file. The content is kept on this computer, so moving or deleting the original file changes nothing.
subRenameHint: You can rename it freely. Its content stays the same.
subRuleHintLocalOwn: Keeps the config's own groups and rules. Node links alone have no rules and use “Hop smart rules” instead.
subRuleHintLocalSmart: Uses only the config's nodes: blocked and overseas sites go through the proxy, sites in mainland China go direct, and sites not on the lists are decided by where their IP is. AI, streaming, Telegram and others are grouped automatically. Good for a server you run yourself.
subRuleHintProvider: Keeps the subscription's own groups and rules. A subscription that is only a node list has no rules and uses “Hop smart rules” instead.
subRuleHintSmart: Uses only the subscription's nodes: blocked and overseas sites go through the proxy, sites in mainland China go direct, and sites not on the lists are decided by where their IP is. AI, streaming, Telegram and others are grouped automatically.
subSourceLocked: The source can't be changed after creation. For a different source, create a new config.
subUnknownRules: This subscription's saved rule setting ({value}) isn't recognised.
subUnknownSource: This config's saved source ({value}) isn't recognised.
subUpdatedDays: {count, plural, one {Updated # day ago} other {Updated # days ago}}
subUpdatedHours: {count, plural, one {Updated # hour ago} other {Updated # hours ago}}
subUpdatedMinutes: {count, plural, one {Updated # minute ago} other {Updated # minutes ago}}
subUpdatedUnknown: Update time unknown. Refresh once to show it
systemProxyHint: Browsers and most apps go through Hop
tunHint: Takes over all traffic, including terminals and games
tunInstallDescription: TUN takes over all traffic and needs Hop's helper installed first. {prompt}. You can uninstall it any time in Settings.
tunPromptMac: macOS will ask for your administrator password once
tunPromptOther: The system will ask for administrator permission once
tunPromptWindows: Windows will show a UAC prompt once
tunTaken: TUN is already in use by {owner}
tunUpdateDescription: TUN takes over all traffic and needs Hop's helper updated first. {prompt}. You can uninstall it any time in Settings.
updateBlockedDev: A dev build can't update itself
updateBlockedReadOnly: The app folder isn't writable, so Hop can't update itself
updateBlockedUnpackaged: Hop isn't running from a packaged app, so it can't update itself
servicesHint: Opens each service the way your rules send it: the route it takes, whether it works and how fast it answers.
serviceRegionTip: The region the service placed you in
actionWatchMemory: Couldn't read the memory in use
lanHintAccount: Devices connect with this account and password. You can turn them off, and see everything, in Settings under LAN.
